title: My situationship sold the sweater I knitted him

voice.name: Kitty
voice.direction: sultry, smirking, brisk TikTok storytelling pace

hooks.text: My situationship said he doesn't do labels.
I bought back the sweater I knitted him for $8.
He resold my hand-knit sweater with no attachment.

beats.text: My situationship said he doesn't do *labels*.
beats.visual: Tiff and Leo on a couch, he shrugs; a 'LABEL' tag on his sweater gets torn off. Text hook: 'I DON'T DO LABELS'.

beats.text: Six months. No title. But he wore the sweater I *knitted* him everywhere.
beats.visual: Montage: Leo in a chunky lilac sweater at a cafe, a party, a bus stop.

beats.text: Then I found it for sale online. Hand-knit, *barely worn*.
beats.visual: Laptop: the sweater's listing photo, on his bedroom floor.

beats.text: Listed for eight dollars. Eight. It took me *three weeks*.
beats.visual: Price tag '$8' slams; calendar with three weeks crossed off.
Listing text zooms; Tiff's eye twitches.

beats.text: So I bought it back. Eight dollars. *Anonymously*.
beats.visual: Tiff in a hoodie and sunglasses at her laptop, clicks BUY.

beats.text: Then I relisted it, with a *new* description.
beats.visual: Tiff typing furiously; new listing card builds.

beats.text: I priced it off real sold listings with *pileGo*: $65.
beats.visual: pileGo board: price suggestion counts up to $65.
SOLD stamp; Tiff spins in her chair.
Tiff holds up the shipping label to camera, smug.
